events.title: Lights of the Ozarks
events.blurb: The historic downtown square glows with holiday lights every night from 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. through Jan. 1. Leashed, well-behaved pets are welcome.
events.blurbEs: La histórica plaza del centro se ilumina con luces navideñas todas las noches de 5 p.m. a 1 a.m. hasta el 1 de enero. Se admiten mascotas con correa y bien portadas.

events.title: Arkansas vs. LSU
events.blurb: The Razorbacks host LSU in SEC football, with kickoff in the 11 a.m.–noon window.
events.blurbEs: Los Razorbacks reciben a LSU en fútbol americano de la SEC, con inicio entre las 11 a.m. y el mediodía.

events.title: Jersey Boys
events.blurb: The Tony-winning musical about Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons in Baum Walker Hall. Recommended for ages 12 and up.
events.blurbEs: El musical ganador del Tony sobre Frankie Valli y The Four Seasons en el Baum Walker Hall. Recomendado para mayores de 12 años.

events.title: Arkansas vs. Louisiana Tech
events.addr: 1270 W Leroy Pond Dr, Fayetteville, AR 72701
events.blurb: Razorbacks women's basketball hosts Louisiana Tech on Sunday afternoon.
events.blurbEs: El baloncesto femenino de las Razorbacks recibe a Louisiana Tech el domingo por la tarde.

events.title: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
events.venue: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
events.blurb: Free general admission to American art and wooded trails in Bentonville, about 25 miles north. Sunday is Museum Store Sunday; some special exhibitions are ticketed.
events.blurbEs: Entrada general gratuita para ver arte estadounidense y senderos boscosos en Bentonville, a unos 40 km al norte. El domingo es Museum Store Sunday; algunas exposiciones especiales requieren boleto.
